name: dashy-avatar
description: Dashy: a living avatar made of two eyes. Pure simulation core, SVG renderer, React components, Swift port.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/dashy.js && esbuild src/react/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --external:react --outfile=dist/react.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
